segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The Graving was full at a quarter to eleven, and the whole of it was green.
segments.instruct: Warm, restrained Australian narration. Quiet observational opening; clear and unhurried. Stay in the same adult narrator voice.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: There were ninety-six of them, and the reserves behind, and they stood on the stone at the bottom of the dock in twenty-four rows of four, in the order of the standing after three boards, with Halden License at the front and the twenty-fourth at the back by the floating gate. The tiers went up round them on three sides, full to the iron and glass roof, and the lamps had been lit along every tier, white and steady. At the seaward end, behind the twenty-fourth, the harbour breathed against the gate's black timber.
segments.instruct: Warm, restrained Australian narration. Clear spatial narration, even register, clean clause boundaries. Stay in the same adult narrator voice.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Perrin wrote: To declare for the four, and keep the brake. Not on the mud. He handed the pen to Anwen. She signed without saying anything, and so did Jude, who steadied the sheet with his left hand while he wrote Talley, because Aske had said Monday, and it was Monday. Pru went scarlet at the table, for no reason anybody could see, and wrote Finch very small.
segments.instruct: Warm, restrained Australian narration. Quiet, exact statements with clear attribution. Stay in the same adult narrator voice.
